title: The promo video, third draft — the tail, the zoom, the whole

steps.headline: The curled tail no longer notches into the bubble; its top edge comes back nearly straight.
steps.changed: The upper edge of the tail used to curve back into the box and left a small notch at the join. Now the lower edge bulges out to the tip and the upper edge returns straight, so the outline flows round it.
steps.notice: The tail reads as one stroke with the bubble, pointing at the mouth.
steps.risk: The tail reaches 22 px toward the mascot, a few pixels more than the old wedge.

steps.path: Every scene that shows the app window
steps.headline: The app is filmed a notch bigger: 135 % instead of 125 %, the way Ctrl and plus does it.
steps.changed: Every desktop scene was re-filmed with the app zoomed to 135 %. Text and controls are about 8 % larger inside the same window; the layouts stayed the same at this size.
steps.notice: Easier to read at a glance. The chat, the model picker, the marketplace, the project page, the games and the phone scene all still show what they showed.
steps.risk: Less of a long conversation fits in the window at once, so some scenes show a line or two less of the app's own text.

steps.headline: Third draft: frosted bubbles with the curled tail, the reworked synthwave, the app at 135 %.
steps.changed: Everything you approved on the first two decks, plus the fixed tail and the bigger zoom, rendered as one film at half size: the file is draft-3.mp4 in your Videos folder under youcoded-promo/draft-2.
steps.notice: The film is still 1:49. If this is the cut, the next step is the full-size render with the loudness pass.
